newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV opens up 13 pct on Caracas bolsa.
newsitem.headline: CANTV opens up 13 pct on Caracas bolsa.

text.p: Venezuelan telephone company CANTV opened up 13 percent at 1,747.50 bolivars ($3.71) from a pricing Thursday of 1,546.80 bolivars ($3.29) on the Caracas bolsa.
"That's a wonderful opening... I can certainly live with that," said InvestAnalysis consultant Alex Dalmady.
The Venezuelan government's offering of its remaining 49 percent stake in CANTV closed Thursday. Today was the first day of trade in the newly issued shares.
On the New York Stock Exchange, CANTV ADRs surged 3 to $26 in the first few minutes of trade. Each ADR represents seven class D shares.
